messages.subject: Thailand executive search | Mining, energy, industrial and country leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Nadal,

Your Boyden profile specifically covers industrial manufacturing, mining, energy, supply chain and multinational organizations, which makes your Thailand practice unusually well matched to my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My career spans 12+ years across mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current remit covers ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

I bring direct operating experience from a major gold-mining business, including regulator and ministry engagement, community relationships, renewable-energy transition work and carbon-data governance. I am now targeting Thailand, ASEAN and APAC mandates where this combination supports country growth and institutional strategy.

I would value consideration for Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or related industrial leadership searches. I have attached a Boyden-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
